SuraLink

Delete your SuraLink account

You can request deletion of your SuraLink account and its cloud learning backup.

In the app

  1. Sign in to the account you want to delete.
  2. Open Profile, then Settings.
  3. Under Your account, choose Delete account and confirm. You may need to sign in again for security.

If you cannot access the app

Email zaine.raja@gmail.com with the subject “SuraLink account deletion request”. Contact us from the email associated with your account, or tell us the sign-in method you used. We may need to verify ownership before acting. Never send a password or payment information.

What is removed

Deletion removes your Firebase sign-in account and the cloud learning backup associated with it. Copies you exported or kept on other devices need to be removed separately. Apple, Google Play and other service providers manage their records under their own policies; contact support with questions about those records.

Cancel a subscription separately

Deleting an account does not cancel a store subscription. Use your Apple ID subscription settings or Google Play’s Payments & subscriptions settings to cancel it.
